name: io.github.bumpsmith/bumpsmith
title: Bumpsmith
description: Upgrade npm and PyPI dependencies across breaking changes, verified with your tests in a sandbox.

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Key for OpenAI or any OpenAI-compatible provider (pass provider in start_upgrade). Optional.
